landing.heroTitle: Your health in your own hands.
landing.heroSub: Small steps today. A healthier tomorrow.
landing.heroBody: Healthy habits are easy to recommend, but hard to sustain. Sukhi helps you turn everyday intentions into healthy habits, stay consistent and find your way back whenever life gets in the way.
landing.howIntro: A simple, personal way to build healthy habits and keep them going.
landing.step1Body: Create a simple daily routine based on your goals, preferences and lifestyle. Start with a few small actions that fit your day.
landing.step2Lead: Not another alarm. A little push when you need it.
landing.step2Body: Sukhi sends timely, personalised reminders and creative nudges that fit your routine and help you stay on track.
landing.step3Body: Went for a walk? Followed your routine? Share a photo, send a voice note or simply tap Done. Sukhi logs your update and celebrates your effort.
landing.step3DidBody: Wonderful! Sukhi records your update and celebrates your effort.
landing.step3NotBody: That's okay too. Sukhi helps you understand what got in the way and find a practical way forward.
landing.step4Body: Build streaks, earn points, celebrate milestones and see how your small daily actions add up over time. One missed day never erases your progress.
landing.whyTitle: More than a tracker. A personal companion.
landing.whyBody: Sukhi understands your routine, nudges you creatively and helps you bounce back after a slip.
landing.why2: Encourages you at the right time.
landing.why3: Finds creative ways to help you continue.
landing.why5: Helps you build consistency for the long run.
landing.whySupport: Because consistency isn't about never missing a day. It's about finding your way back.
landing.whyChatUser: I couldn't go for my walk today.
landing.whyChatReply: That's okay. Some days don't go as planned. Would you like to try a shorter walk tomorrow?
landing.benefitsIntro: Build small, manageable habits across the things that matter.
landing.domSleepBody: Create a routine that supports better rest.
landing.domMedsBody: Stay organised with reminders for your prescribed schedule.
landing.featuresBody: A walk completed. A routine followed. Share these moments with Sukhi through a photo, a voice note or a tap, and watch your progress grow.
landing.feat1: Tap Done or check in by voice
landing.feat3: Get gentle reminders that suit your day
landing.featCardWelcome: Welcome back! Ready for one small step today?
landing.langTitle: Talk to Sukhi the way you talk every day.
landing.langBody: Speak and share in the language that feels natural to you: English, Hindi or Marathi.
landing.a1: Sukhi is a personal wellbeing companion that helps you build simple daily routines, check in on your progress and find a way forward when you miss a day.
landing.a2: You can tap Done, type a short update or use your voice. You can also add a photo if you like. It's never required as proof.
landing.q3: What happens if I miss a day?
landing.a3: Sukhi keeps a record of your check-ins and can suggest a gentler way to restart. One missed day never erases your progress.
landing.q4: Can family members see my activity?
landing.a4: Family sharing is optional. You decide what is shared, and family never see your private chats. You can stop sharing at any time.
landing.q5: Is Sukhi a substitute for my doctor?
landing.a5: No. Sukhi supports everyday wellbeing routines and does not provide medical diagnosis or replace professional advice.
landing.q6: Do I need to download an app?
landing.a6: No. Sukhi works in your phone's browser and can be added to your home screen.
landing.ctaTitle: Small steps today. A healthier tomorrow.
landing.ctaBody: You don't have to change everything overnight. Start with one small step. Let Sukhi help you keep going.
landing.footerDisclaimer: Sukhi supports everyday wellbeing habits and routines. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
landing.roadmapBody: What we're building next, so Sukhi can support every part of your health routine, wherever you are and whoever helps you.
landing.roadmapNote: Plans may change. Health features are reviewed with clinicians, and anything that uses your data is switched on only with your consent.
landing.rm1_3: Android and iOS apps with push notifications and offline use
landing.rm1_5: More Indian languages: Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada and more
landing.rm2_1: Steps and sleep from Google Health Connect, Apple Health, Fitbit and Garmin
landing.rm2_2: Readings from Bluetooth BP monitors and glucometers, logged automatically
landing.rm2_3: ABHA / ABDM records: import prescriptions and discharge summaries
landing.rm2_4: Lab reports read into a simple, shareable timeline
landing.rm2_5: Medicine stock tracking and pharmacy refill reminders
landing.rm3_1: A family app with shared reminders and consent-based alerts
landing.rm3_2: A clinic dashboard to share plans and see progress, with permission
landing.rm3_3: Doctor-visit prep: your questions and recent progress in one page
landing.rm3_4: Teleconsult booking with your own doctor
landing.rm3_5: A mode for community health workers who support many families
landing.rm4_1: Routine suggestions learned from your own week, always yours to accept
landing.rm4_2: Indian meal photos turned into simple food logs
landing.rm4_3: Mood, stress and sleep check-ins with guided breathing
landing.rm4_4: Festival, travel and fasting-aware schedules you confirm
landing.rm4_5: Family challenges and rewards for showing up
landing.heroInstall: Install Sukhi on your phone (free, no app store)
landing.installBody: Sukhi installs straight from your browser in under a minute and works like a regular app, with its own icon and phone notifications.
landing.installDone: Installed. Open Sukhi from your home screen.
landing.installIphoneNote: Use Safari. Phone notifications need iOS 16.4 or later.
landing.ios2: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow), then “Add to Home Screen”, then “Add”.
landing.ios3: Open Sukhi from the new icon on your Home Screen and sign up or log in.
landing.ios4: Tap “Turn on notifications” and allow them, so reminders reach you.
landing.and2: Tap “Install” on the banner, or open the ⋮ menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
landing.and3: Open Sukhi, sign up or log in, and tap “Turn on notifications”.
landing.installQrBody: Scan with your phone's camera to open Sukhi there.
landing.installTip: Tip: in Settings → Phone notifications, tap “Send a test” to check that reminders arrive.

legal.draftNote: Pilot version, last updated 11 November 2026. This summary is under legal review.
legal.privacyIntro: Sukhi exists to help you keep a routine. We collect only what that needs, and you stay in control of it.
legal.pCollectBody: Your account email, the preferences you set, your plan, your check-ins, notes, photos and voice-note transcripts, and the messages you exchange with Sukhi. Proof photos and videos are deleted after 7 days. The result of each check stays in your history.
legal.pUseBody: To schedule reminders, answer your questions from your own plan, show your progress, and keep an honest history. We don't sell your information or use it for advertising.
legal.pProcessorsBody: Supabase stores your data. If you allow it, Anthropic helps the assistant and photo descriptions, and our speech provider (ElevenLabs) turns voice notes into text and reads replies aloud. If you connect WhatsApp, Meta delivers those messages.
legal.pFamilyBody: Nothing is shared unless you invite someone. Invited family see weekly participation counts only, and you can stop sharing at any time. If you link a doctor, they see how much of your plan you follow and your proof results, never your chats. A small Sukhi review team may look at proof photos to check them; nobody else does.
legal.pChoicesBody: Turn AI, voice, reminders, WhatsApp and family sharing on or off in Settings. You can delete your account and all its data from Settings at any time.
legal.termsIntro: By using Sukhi you agree to these terms.
legal.tWhatBody: Sukhi is a companion that helps you follow a routine you have agreed on with your care team or set for yourself. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.
legal.tCareBody: Always follow your doctor's instructions. Never change, skip or double medicines because of something in Sukhi. In an emergency, call 112 or your local emergency number.
legal.tAccountBody: Keep your login details private. Only enter information about yourself, or about someone who has asked you to help them.
legal.tUseBody: Don't misuse the service, try to access other people's information, or send harmful content.
legal.tChangesBody: Sukhi may change as we learn. We will tell you about important changes in the app.

support.promptTitle: Choose how Sukhi talks to you
support.promptBody: Pick a style, and what helps when a day doesn't go to plan. Takes 20 seconds.
support.offer_encouragement: Would a little help to restart be useful?
support.offer_simpler_alternative: Want to find an easier way to make room for it?
support.offer_gentle_push: Shall we pick it back up today?

warm_gentle.1: How did “{title}” go yesterday? If it didn't happen, that's completely okay.
warm_gentle.2: Just checking on “{title}” from yesterday. Whatever happened, today is a new chance.

fun_playful.1: Quick check: did “{title}” make it into yesterday? No worries if it took a day off!
fun_playful.2: “{title}” yesterday: done, or did the day have other plans? Either is fine!

motivating.1: How did “{title}” go yesterday? Whatever the answer, your progress still counts.
motivating.2: Yesterday's “{title}”: done or not, today is your next step.

warm_gentle.1: Yesterday's “{title}” didn't go as planned, and that's okay.

fun_playful.1: Plans sometimes take a little detour! “{title}” can get back on track.
fun_playful.2: “{title}” took a day off yesterday. We can invite it back.

motivating.1: One missed day doesn't erase your progress with “{title}”.

warm_gentle.1: That happens to everyone. Would a different reminder time for “{title}” help?
warm_gentle.2: Forgetting is normal. Shall we try a time for “{title}” that's easier to remember?

fun_playful.1: Memory took a holiday? Let's find a time “{title}” can't sneak past.
fun_playful.2: No problem! Maybe “{title}” needs a better time slot. Want to try one?

motivating.1: Easy fix: pick a time for “{title}” that suits your day better.
motivating.2: Let's make it stick. Would a different time for “{title}” work better?

simple_practical.1: Would another reminder time for “{title}” help?

warm_gentle.1: Busy days happen. Would a different time feel easier for “{title}”?
warm_gentle.2: It sounds like a full day. Shall we find a calmer time for “{title}”?

fun_playful.1: Your day was packed! Want to move “{title}” to a quieter slot?
fun_playful.2: Busy, busy! Maybe “{title}” would like a new time. Shall we try?

motivating.1: Let's work with your schedule. Which time suits “{title}” best?
motivating.2: A better time can make all the difference. Want to choose one for “{title}”?

simple_practical.2: Choose a more convenient time for “{title}”?

warm_gentle.1: Some days are like that, and that's okay. Even a small start counts.
warm_gentle.2: Low-energy days are normal. Be kind to yourself and try again when it feels right.

fun_playful.1: Even superheroes have slow days! A tiny start still counts.
fun_playful.2: Motivation is shy sometimes. Let's tempt it with a tiny first step!

motivating.1: You've done this before, and you can again. What's one small step for today?
motivating.2: Progress isn't about perfect days. One small step keeps you going.

simple_practical.1: That's okay. A small start next time still counts.
simple_practical.2: Noted. Try a small start next time.

warm_gentle.1: Changes in routine are hard. Would a new time for “{title}” suit you better for now?
warm_gentle.2: When life shifts, plans can shift too. Shall we find a new time for “{title}”?

fun_playful.1: Life rearranged the furniture! Want to find “{title}” a new spot in your day?
fun_playful.2: New routine, new slot? Let's find a good time for “{title}”.

motivating.1: Adapting is a strength. Pick the next good time for “{title}”.
motivating.2: Let's keep going in your new routine. What time would suit “{title}” now?

simple_practical.1: Your routine changed. Pick a new time for “{title}”?
simple_practical.2: Want to set a new time for “{title}”?

warm_gentle.1: Thank you for telling me. Would a smaller version of “{title}” feel more doable for now?
warm_gentle.2: It's fine to start smaller. You could make “{title}” lighter in My plan.

fun_playful.1: Too big a bite? Let's make “{title}” snack-sized!
fun_playful.2: No need to climb the whole mountain! A smaller “{title}” still counts.

motivating.1: Smaller steps still build the habit. Want to make “{title}” easier for now?
motivating.2: Start small, grow later. Shall we shrink “{title}” a little?

simple_practical.2: Want to set an easier version of “{title}”?

warm_gentle.1: Thank you for telling me. We can try again whenever you're ready.
warm_gentle.2: That's okay. I'm here when you want to try again.

motivating.1: Thanks for sharing. The next chance is a fresh start.
motivating.2: Noted. You can pick it back up any time.

simple_practical.1: Thanks. We'll try again next time.

neutral.1: Thank you for telling me. Please keep following your plan as your care team wrote it. If the timing is hard, ask your doctor or care team whether it can be adjusted.
neutral.2: Thanks for letting me know. I can't change this part of your plan, but your doctor or care team can help if the timing doesn't work for you.

neutral.1: Thank you for telling me. Please don't push through pain or discomfort. Rest, and check with your doctor or care team before doing this activity again. If it feels severe or sudden, call 112 or get help nearby now.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.body: Get reminders and check-ins on this phone, even when Sukhi is closed.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.testSent: Sent. It should appear in a few seconds.
push.testFailed: Couldn't send. Turn notifications off and on again.
push.error: Couldn't turn on notifications. Please try again.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Sukhi. Allow them in your phone or browser settings, then try again.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. On Android use Chrome; on iPhone add Sukhi to your Home Screen.
push.iosHint: On iPhone: open Sukhi in Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open Sukhi from your Home Screen and turn notifications on here.
push.notConfigured: Phone notifications aren't set up on this server yet.
push.promptBody: Turn on notifications so reminders reach you even when Sukhi is closed.
push.help: Turn this on for each phone or browser you use. Quiet hours are respected.

companion.refillLow: Your “{title}” will run out in about {days} days. You may want to arrange a refill.
companion.refillOut: Your “{title}” stock may have run out. Please arrange a refill, and ask your pharmacist or doctor if you're unsure what to do.
companion.family_inactive: {name} hasn't checked in or opened Sukhi for 2 days. You may want to say hello.
companion.family_low_stock: {name}'s medicine is running low and may need a refill soon.
companion.family_not_well: {name} told Sukhi they're not feeling well today and asked to let you know.
companion.pushReminder: Time for: {title}. Tap to check in.
companion.pushTest: Notifications are working. This is how reminders will look.
companion.stockHint: Each “done” uses one dose. This only counts what you have; it never changes your schedule or dose.
companion.pauseHint: Reminders stop now and come back by themselves on that date. For a doctor's plan, check with your doctor before pausing.
companion.pauseBadDate: Pick a date between tomorrow and 90 days from now.
companion.lowMood: Thank you for sharing. A slow minute of breathing can help you settle.
companion.helpline: If you feel overwhelmed or unsafe, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24×7), or 112 in an emergency.
companion.familyNone: No family member has alerts turned on.
companion.breatheBody: Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, and breathe out slowly for 6. Follow the circle.
companion.breatheNote: This is a relaxation exercise, not a treatment. Stop if you feel dizzy.
companion.breatheDone: Well done. Notice how you feel.
companion.alertsScopeHelp: They get a notification if you have no check-ins for 2 days, if a tracked medicine runs low, or when you choose “Let my family know”. They never see your plan, messages or health details.
companion.alertsMemberHelp: Turn on notifications on this phone to get these alerts straight away.
